answer.explanation: The visible log events show successful invocations across all four functions with no ERROR, timeout, AccessDenied or throttling lines. Durations are stable and well under typical limits. Max Memory Used stays well below configured memory (CrudApi about 87-95 of 128 MB, Uploader about 100-101 of 256 MB, Compression about 102-106 of 1024 MB, Thumbnailer about 110-112 of 1024 MB). The CrudApi INIT_START and Init Duration entries (about 380-470 ms) are ordinary cold starts, not a configuration fault. The 4345 truncated events could hide a problem, but the visible window shows no anomaly.
